
[yellow bold]-- DEPRECATION -- main.volt:2[/yellow bold]

Move `chip esp32` to volt.toml: chip = "esp32"

 [dim]1 |[/dim] 
 [dim]2 |[/dim] chip esp32
 [dim]  |[/dim] [yellow]     ^^^^^[/yellow]

[cyan]Hint: The chip declaration will move to volt.toml in a future version.[/cyan]


[yellow bold]-- HARDWARE WARNING -- main.volt:5[/yellow bold]

Strapping pin: GPIO 2 must be LOW during boot for flash programming.

 [dim]4 |[/dim] hardware {
 [dim]5 |[/dim]     pin led: Output = 2
 [dim]  |[/dim] [yellow]        ^^^[/yellow]


[yellow bold]-- HARDWARE WARNING -- main.volt:6[/yellow bold]

Strapping pin: GPIO 0 must be HIGH during boot (pulled up by default). If driven LOW externally, the chip enters bootloader mode.

 [dim]5 |[/dim]     pin led: Output = 2
 [dim]6 |[/dim]     pin button: PullUpInput = 0
 [dim]  |[/dim] [yellow]        ^^^^^^[/yellow]


[yellow bold]-- CONCURRENCY WARNING -- main.volt:9[/yellow bold]

Variable `counter` is written by 2 tasks: task_a, task_b. Each write is atomic, but the last one wins.

 [dim]8 |[/dim] 
 [dim]9 |[/dim] var counter = 0
 [dim]  |[/dim] [yellow]    ^^^^^^^[/yellow]

[cyan]Hint: Consider using a channel for inter-task communication.[/cyan]
